phase: Stage 2B hardening: privacy-aware real-query collection protocol and de-identification checklist gate for the future 50-100 real anonymized query set. The real query-set parent item remains unchecked; only the collection protocol/checklist scaffold is a checked sub-note.
summary: Added docs/STAGE2B_REAL_QUERY_COLLECTION_PROTOCOL.md, examples/real_query_collection_packet.example.json, build_real_query_collection_protocol(config=None), validate_real_query_collection_packet(packet), and tools/check_real_query_collection_protocol.py. The protocol covers data minimization, de-identification checklist, pseudonymization notes, retention/disposal, access control, and handoff into the real_query_set artifact contract. The validator checks declared packet metadata/checklist shape only: collector role, purpose, retention policy, access-control summary, all de-identification checklist items true, target_count in [50,100], and no PII-shaped sample values. It collects no real queries, reads no secrets, and never marks the parent ROADMAP item complete.
